scientific.integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the model equation, parameter definitions, population/deceased bounds, displayed virus bound and feasible region, disease-free global-stability argument, and persistence-to-endemic-equilibrium argument. The virus-equation/bound page was visually inspected. The correction is proved analytically and replayed by an exact certificate. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result repairs the virus-coordinate bound and rectangular invariant region. The cap is sharp relative to the source's rectangular upstream bounds, not asserted to be the exact maximum over every reachable set. No claim is made that the reproduction number or equilibrium formulas must change.

title: Sharp virus-concentration cap repairs the invariant region in a metacommunity COVID-19 model
